verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair capability to ask of an observability platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no bulk operations, such as bulk-editing rules, cases, or documents. Fleet's central agent management and ES|QL querying over millions of series are adjacent features, not documented bulk actions across many items, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
